en: A color view of a seaside quay with a red-brick hotel or commercial building to the left, outdoor café tables along the waterfront, and a row of parked 1950s-era cars on the right. Several flagpoles stand near the center flying the Swedish flag, the United States flag, and at least one other flag. In the background are boats, a small harbor, and low rocky islands or coastline under a clear blue sky.
